title: Mt Kodu/Kokoda Track landowner blockade over unpaid PNG government compensation
location: Naoro/Nauro and Kokoda Track, Central Province; some reports describe the full 96 km trail, while the precise barricaded stretch is not uniform
public_gathering: Landowner track closure/blockade documented; simultaneous number of landowners at the action is unknown.
domestic_state_demand: Outstanding PNG government compensation payment (K40 million of a promised K50 million) for foregoing the Kodu mining project.
continuity: Government press release on Dec 3 confirms landowners closed the track on Sep 16; NBC reports reopened on Thursday Dec 5 after nearly four months.
state_response: Government appeal and assurance of payment; track reopened after an agreement. Official payment processing remained contingent on NEC approval in the NBC report.
notes: Not a December-start event; the reopening is not itself a new protest. Do not use tourists, event attendees, corridor population, ministers or officials as protester count.

start_date.summary: Official PMNEC release gives 16 September; The National search result reports same.

end_date.summary: NBC reports reopening on Thursday in its Dec 6 story; The National result says it would reopen Dec 5.

location.summary: Kodu landowners, Naoro and Kokoda Track, Central Province.

demand.summary: Outstanding payment from PNG government to Kodu landowners.

state_response.summary: PM appealed for reopening and assured the government would pay outstanding amount; first tranche still awaited NEC approval.
